title: Backpressure, felt
blurb: Drag the producer rate above what the consumer can absorb and watch the queue decide who suffers. The three strategies are the three real options.

title: Consistent hashing
blurb: Add and remove nodes from a hash ring and see exactly which keys move. The whole argument for virtual nodes in about nine seconds.

title: Latency, to scale
blurb: The numbers every engineer should know, drawn at actual relative size. An L1 reference is one pixel. A round trip to Mumbai is a very long line.

title: Why p99 is the number that matters
blurb: Fan out a request to N backends and watch the median stay flat while the tail eats you alive.
